race.description: Celebrating Race Zone 20 Years Mdn Plate
race.comment: BROTHER (6) looks the pick of the debutants off a recent Doomben trial win and can kick things off with a bang for the Tony Gollan camp. Gun hoop Benny Thompson has piloted in all three trials to date and it's a great sign that he sticks with him here. TWO MINDS (4) returns and makes her third stable debut in as many starts. Hasn't been far away in both runs to date, particularly last time when beaten a nose at Toowoomba off a long break, in what subsequently proved a hot maiden. Has been fitted with just the one trial but gets Ange Jones from the inside pillar. Expecting him to play a role. KEEN TO BEGIN (10) has race fitness on her side after a second at Ballina, where she finished strongly. With natural improvement in store she can play a major role. ENTERPRISE GISELLE (8) only warmed into it late when resuming on the Gold Coast Poly. Senior hoop takes over and suspect he will be keen to settle her closer.
